alt: 幾組遊客分別走花圃步道、石階與林間小徑，三條不同路線最後都通往同一座山頂涼亭。
scene_prompt: Modern community hill park shown in an elevated wide view. Three clearly separate winding footpaths start at different lower edges and converge at ONE distinctive hexagonal hilltop pavilion in upper center. One family takes the gentle left path through flower beds, two hikers take middle stone steps, a child with a parent takes the curving right wooded path. All groups face and progress toward the SAME pavilion, with one member of each group reaching its single shared plaza. Paths remain physically connected and visible, no impossible crossing. Each route uses a different approach yet ends at identical goal, as in the MOE example of different hiking trails reaching same pavilion. Safe railings on steps, coherent perspective and grounded walking anatomy. No signposts or readable text, no arrows needed, no logos or watermarks. 3:2 landscape, graphite watercolor colored-pencil grain on ivory paper.
